title: Earnings Beat: Can Palantir sustain its explosive AI-driven growth?
description: Palantir Technologies stunned Wall Street by delivering another quarter of explosive growth, fueled by surging demand for its artificial intelligence software from both government agencies and commercial customers. The company raised its full-year revenue forecast to $8.15 billion-$8.16 billion, up from its previous outlook of about $7.65 billion, after reporting second-quarter revenue of $1.94 billion, well ahead of analysts' expectations. The upbeat guidance sent Palantir shares soaring around 14% in after-hours trading. (Sources: Reuters, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal) Palantir raises outlook after blockbuster quarter
